descriptions.zh:
终于，星海参议院投票通过授予[custodian.GetName]紧急监管权。在一个向全星系广播的官方典礼上，我们被任命为§H星海共同体监管人§!。

作为同侪之首，我们负责保卫星海共同体的安全，抵御一切来自内部或外部的潜在威胁。我们在整个共同体的各项事务上被赋予了极大的权力，并且可以提出特殊的议案。
descriptions.en:
At last, the Galactic Senate has voted to bestow emergency Custodianship powers upon the [custodian.GetName]. In an official ceremony broadcast across the galaxy, we were appointed §HCustodians of the Galactic Community§!.

As the first among equals, we have been charged with safeguarding the Galactic Community from all potential threats, be they internal or external, who would seek it harm. We have been granted vast powers in all Community matters and can now propose special resolutions.

descriptions.zh:
星海参议院投票通过授予§H[custodian.GetName]§!紧急监管权。在一个向全星系广播的官方典礼上，他们被任命为§H星海共同体监管人§!。

作为同侪之首，[custodian.GetSpeciesName]政府负责保卫星海共同体的安全，抵御一切来自内部或外部的潜在威胁。他们在整个共同体的各项事务上被赋予了极大的权力，并且可以提出特殊的议案。
descriptions.en:
The Galactic Senate has voted to bestow emergency Custodianship powers upon the §H[custodian.GetName]§!. In a ceremony broadcast across the galaxy, they were appointed the official §HCustodians of the Galactic Community§!.

As the first among equals, the [custodian.GetSpeciesName] government is now charged with safeguarding the Galactic Community from all potential threats, be they internal or external, who would seek it harm. They have been granted vast powers in all Community matters and can now propose special resolutions.

label.zh: 现在我们可以大有作为了。
label.en: Now we can get things done.

tooltips.en: The §Y[custodian.GetName]§! are now §YCustodians of the Galactic Community§!.

label.zh: 让我们看看这样会如何。
label.en: We shall see how this works out.

tooltips.en: The §Y[custodian.GetName]§! are now §YCustodians of the Galactic Community§!.

descriptions.zh: 我们作为星海共同体监管人的任期已经结束。监管人职能终止，我们的特殊权力也解除了，当然我们依然还维持着在星系理事会中的席位。
descriptions.en: Our term as the Custodians of the Galactic Community has reached its end. The Custodianship has been terminated and our special powers rescinded, although we have retained our seat on the Galactic Council.

descriptions.zh: 随着他们的任期结束，§H[former_custodians.GetName]§!放弃了他们作为星海共同体监管人的地位。他们的特殊权力也废除了，当然他们依然还维持着在星系理事会中的席位。
descriptions.en: With their term at an end, the §H[former_custodians.GetName]§! has given up their status as the Custodians of the Galactic Community. Their special powers have been rescinded, and they are now considered a regular member of the Galactic Council.

tooltips.en: The §Y[From.GetName]§! are no longer §YCustodians of the Galactic Community§!.

descriptions.zh: 我们终于摆脱了吃力不讨好的监管人职位！让其他随便什么人去担心这帮忘恩负义的家伙们的未来吧。
descriptions.en: Finally we are rid of the thankless and futile Custodianship! Let someone else worry about the future of this ungrateful galaxy.

descriptions.zh: §H[former_custodians.GetName]§!提前结束了他们在星海共同体中的监管人任期。似乎他们并不愿意承担监管人的责任。
descriptions.en: The §H[former_custodians.GetName]§! has prematurely ended their term as Custodians of the Galactic Community. It seems the responsibilities of the Custodianship weren't to their liking.

label.zh: 我们已经尽我们所能了。

tooltips.en: The §Y[From.GetName]§! are no longer §YCustodians of the Galactic Community§!.
The §Y[From.GetName]§! are no longer §YCustodians of the Galactic Community§!.

descriptions.zh: 星海参议院里忘恩负义的傻瓜们投票结束我们作为监管人的任期！我们被剥夺了所有的相关职责。
descriptions.en: The ungrateful fools in the Galactic Senate have voted to terminate our Custodianship! We have been stripped of all Community powers that were associated with the office.

descriptions.zh: 在通过突然且充满羞辱的方式剥夺了他们的监管权之后，星海参议院多数投票统一立即将§Y[From.GetName]§!从星海监管人职位移除。他们被剥夺了星海共同体赋予的特殊权力。
descriptions.en: In a sudden and humiliating end to their Custodianship, the Galactic Senate majority has voted to immediate remove the §Y[From.GetName]§! from the office of Galactic Custodian. They have been stripped of their special Community powers.

tooltips.en: The §Y[From.GetName]§! are no longer §YCustodians of the Galactic Community§!.

label.en: That is the end of that.

tooltips.en: The §Y[From.GetName]§! are no longer §YCustodians of the Galactic Community§!.

descriptions.zh:
参议院已经批准建立一支常设的多国联合武装部队，意在防卫星海共同体。这支“§H泛星系防卫军§!”将会从所有共同体成员国当中征募兵员，成员国要求贡献自己的一部分资源来支持舰队的建设。

泛星系防卫军现在已经处于§H[custodian.GetName]§!——现任监管人——的直接控制之下，有关人士担忧这支庞大的舰队会成为镇压反对意见的工具。然而，也有不少人对其创立拍手称快，称这支舰队“始终活跃在星系防卫的最前线”。
descriptions.en:
The Senate has ratified the creation of a standing multinational military force intended for the defense of the Galactic Community. This "§HGalactic Defense Force§!" will recruit its personnel from all Community members, who are also required to contribute resources towards the construction of its fleets.

With the GDF being placed under the direct command of the §H[custodian.GetName]§!, the current Galactic Custodians, some fear that this potentially massive armada could be used as a tool of oppression. Others, however, applaud its creation, referring to it as "the galaxy's first line of defense."

descriptions.zh:
参议院已经批准建立一支常设的多国联合武装部队，意在防卫星海共同体。这支“§H泛星系防卫军§!”将会从所有共同体成员国当中征募兵员，成员国要求贡献自己的一部分资源来支持舰队的建设。

由于星系全境陷入混乱，并受到了意在消灭所有智慧生命体的势力的长期威胁，各界衷心希望泛星系防卫军能够对敌人发动打击，以维系星海共同体的边疆安全。星海监管人§H[custodian.GetName]§!将直接指挥舰队，负责领导这次行动。
descriptions.en:
The Senate has ratified the creation of a standing multinational military force intended for the defense of the Galactic Community. This "§HGalactic Defense Force§!" will recruit its personnel from all Community members, who are also required to contribute resources towards the construction of its fleets.

With the galaxy engulfed in turmoil and under constant threat by forces that seek to exterminate all sapient life, it is hoped that the GDF will be able to bring the fight to the enemy and secure the borders of the Community. They will be placed under the direct command of the §H[custodian.GetName]§!, the Galactic Custodians.

descriptions.zh:
参议院已经批准建立一支常设的多国联合武装部队，意在防卫星海共同体。这支“§H泛星系防卫军§!”将会从所有共同体成员国当中征募兵员，成员国要求贡献自己的一部分资源来支持舰队的建设。

由于星系全境陷入混乱，各界衷心希望泛星系防卫军能够进一步扩编增长实力，以应对失落帝国为了征服星系全境而派遣出来的庞大舰队。星海监管人§H[custodian.GetName]§!将直接指挥舰队。
descriptions.en:
The Senate has ratified the creation of a standing multinational military force intended for the defense of the Galactic Community. This "§HGalactic Defense Force§!" will recruit its personnel from all Community members, who are also required to contribute resources towards the construction of its fleets.

With the galaxy engulfed by war, it is hoped that the GDF will expand to become strong enough to challenge even the vast fleets being thrown around by the Fallen Empires in their petty squabbles for galactic dominance. They will be placed under the direct command of the §H[custodian.GetName]§!, the Galactic Custodians.

label.zh: 本星系将会变成一个更加安全的地方。
label.en: The galaxy will become a safer place.

label.zh: 这支可怜的舰队将会被歼灭，直到最后一艘舰船损失殆尽。
label.en: This pathetic fleet will be exterminated to the last ship.

titles.zh: 泛星系防卫军暂停行动

descriptions.zh: 由于星海监管人的职位现在空缺，泛星系防卫军设立了一个独立的指挥架构。他们依然致力于保护星海共同体，泛星系防卫军的指挥高层宣誓将继续巡逻成员国的恒星系。
descriptions.en: With the office of the Galactic Custodian now vacant, the Galactic Defense Force has established an independent command structure. They remain dedicated towards the protection of the Community, and GDF High Command has vowed to maintain their patrols of member systems.

label.zh: 他们的警觉令人肃然起敬。

titles.zh: 泛星系防卫军向监管人报告

descriptions.zh: 由于我们已经肩负了星海监管人的职责，泛星系防卫军现在被纳入我们的指挥架构。他们等待我们在未来的进一步指示。
descriptions.en: As we have assumed the office of the Galactic Custodian, the Galactic Defense Force has been folded into our command structure. They will now look to us for future orders.

tooltips.zh: 所有泛星系防卫军下辖的舰队现在受我们指挥。
tooltips.en: All GDF fleets are now under our command.

descriptions.zh: 依照参议院大多数的表决，§H泛星系防卫军§!被解散了。所有现役的泛星系防卫军人员将返回其母国，而防卫军的战舰将在参议院官员的密切监督下拆解，以防止这些战舰落入心有不轨之人的手中。
descriptions.en: By order of the Senate majority, the §HGalactic Defense Force§! has been disbanded. All serving GDF personnel have returned to their home nations, and their warships are being scuttled under the close supervision of Senate officials to prevent them from falling into the wrong hands.

titles.zh: 与星海监管人并肩而战……
titles.en: Stand by for the Galactic Custodian...

descriptions.zh:
星海共同体的可敬成员们……智慧生物同胞们。

星海正格外黑暗。我们面临的生死危机史无前例。为了挺过接下来的猛攻，我们必须如同明天我们将不复存在一般战斗，因为，我们也许真的没有明天了。

在你们选举我们成为星海监管人时，我们宣誓要捍卫星系，拼尽一切来兑现承诺……但这并非一场我们独自能够赢得的战役。我们吁请全体成员国搁置异见，与我们并肩反击§H[crisis_country.GetName]§!的进攻！只要齐心协力，我们定能展现星海的完整威力，抵御共同的敌人。
descriptions.en:
Honorable members of the Galactic Community... fellow sapients.

This is an exceedingly dark time for our galaxy. The existential threat we face is without precedent. To survive the coming onslaught, we must fight like there is no tomorrow, for in truth, that may be the case.

When you elected us as your Galactic Custodians, we swore an oath to defend our galaxy and we will do everything in our power to uphold that promise... but this is not a battle we can win alone. We call on all members to put aside their differences and join us as we strike back at the §H[crisis_country.GetName]§!! Together we will show them the full might of our galaxy as it stands united against a common foe!

descriptions.zh:
星海已四面楚歌！§H[crisis_country.GetName]§!盯上了我们的军队，但我们毫无能长时间抵抗的希望！

作为星海的监管人，保护全体共同体成员不受外界的威胁是您应尽的职责，请尽您所能地提供援助吧！
descriptions.en:
The galaxy is under attack! Our forces have engaged the §H[crisis_country.GetName]§!, but we have little hope of holding them off for long!

As the Galactic Custodians, it is your duty to defend all Community members from external threats! Please, send all the help you can!

descriptions.zh: 随着§H[LastKilledCountryName]§!的覆灭，他们作为星海共同体监管人的任期也不复存在了。
descriptions.en: With the destruction of the §H[LastKilledCountryName]§!, their Custodianship of the Galactic Community has come to an end.
